{{Top}}
{{Quote|She's rich&hellip;|[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], persuading [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] to rescue the imprisoned Leia Organa on the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]]|<ref name="Episode 4">{{Film|IV}}</ref>}}
[[File:Star_Wars_Princess_FDCR.png|thumb|right|250px|A princess sitting on her throne]]
'''Princess''' was a title of [[Noble|nobility]] held by [[Gender/Legends|females]]. It was used to indicate the heir of a monarch, such as Princess [[Syayna]] or Princess [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]]; the heir of a [[Chief/Legends|chieftain]], such as Princess [[Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka/Legends|Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka]].  "[[Prince/Legends|Prince]]" was a typically masculine equivalent of "princess."

There were also titles such as [[Princess of Theed]], which was an electoral position, held by numerous persons, including the future [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|Monarch of Naboo]] (the [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]]), [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]]. However, this title did not mean that Padmé's parents were the [[King/Legends|King]] and [[Queen/Legends|Queen]]; it was a title which later gave her an advantage in the monarch elections of [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].<ref name="T5ASD">{{Tales|5|A Summer's Dream}}</ref>

In the case of the [[Fel Empire]], the heir of [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Roan Fel]] was his daughter, Princess [[Marasiah Fel]].<ref name="SWLO">[[Star Wars: Legacy (2006) 0|''Star Wars: Legacy'' (2006) 0]]</ref>
